prompt:
ANIMATION SPRITE SHEET of a WALK CYCLE: 12 frames in a grid of 4 columns x 3 rows (read left to right, top to bottom), every cell the same size, the SAME basic zombie in every frame (brown torn suit jacket, white shirt, red striped necktie, blue ragged trousers, brown shoes, grey-green skin, big round eyes), exactly on-model with the attached references, seen from the side facing LEFT and walking to the LEFT. In EVERY cell the zombie is the same size, the torso is in the same horizontal place (the necktie at the cell's centre line), and the shoe soles rest on the same ground line near the bottom of the cell. Both arms hang limply down in front of the body with the hands at hip height in every frame (only a slight swing). The upper body is hunched forward.
The legs do a proper, clearly readable walking stride, with BIG leg movement. Call the leg nearer to the viewer the NEAR leg and the other the FAR leg:
1) CONTACT: near leg stretched far forward to the left, heel touching the ground; far leg stretched far back to the right, only its toes touching the ground. Wide stride.
2) DOWN: near foot now flat on the ground a little to the left of the body, knee bent; far foot behind, heel lifting off.
3) far foot lifted off the ground behind, far knee bending, near leg below the body.
4) PASSING: near leg straight and vertical under the body, foot flat; far knee raised high in front, its foot lifted well off the ground beside the near shin.
5) far leg swinging forward to the left, foot still in the air; near foot flat but now a little to the right of the body.
6) far leg reaching forward to the left about to touch down; near leg behind on its toes.
7) CONTACT, mirrored: far leg stretched far forward to the left, heel touching; near leg stretched far back, only toes touching. Wide stride.
8) DOWN: far foot flat on the ground a little left of the body, knee bent; near heel lifting off behind.
9) near foot lifted off behind, near knee bending.
10) PASSING: far leg straight and vertical under the body; near knee raised high in front, its foot well off the ground.
11) near leg swinging forward, foot in the air; far foot now a little to the right of the body.
12) near leg reaching forward about to touch down; far leg behind on its toes.
The foot that stands on the ground moves steadily from left to right relative to the body from one frame to the next (the body passes over it). Clear gaps between the cells; the whole zombie inside its cell. No text, no numbers, no motion lines, no shadows.
